sentences.text: Shri Bheem Choudhary, Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Manas Mani Verma, Govt. Advocate for the responde
Heard on I.A.No.7078/2026, for grant of temporary suspension of sentence and bail to appellant
Ranjeet.

This appeal under Section 374(2) of Cr.P.C. is filed by appellant being aggrieved of the judgment dated 11.04.2023, passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), II Addl. sessions Judge, Rehli,
District Sagar (M.P.), in SC No.09/2021, whereby, appellant stands convicted for offences under Sections 376(3) read with Section 5(L)N/6 of POCSO Act for which he is sentenced to imprisonment for life and fine of Rs.400/- and Section 506(Part-II) of IPC and he is sentenced to undergo R.I. for 07 years and fine of Rs.100/-, respectively, with default stipulations.

entities.text:
Special Judge (POCSO Act), II Addl. sessions Judge, Rehli,
District Sagar (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant lost his father Delan Sen on 17.03.2026 at Village Chandpur, Police Station Rehli, District Sagar (M.P.).
His 13th day function is to be performed on 29.03.2026.
On this ground alone, learned counsel prays for suspension of sentence and grant of temporary bail to the appellant.

Shri Manas Mani Verma, learned Govt. Advocate has produced report from SHO Police Station Rehli, District Sagar, confirming death of father of appellant on 17.03.2026 with a further fact that 13th day function is to be 2 CRA-15838-2023 performed on 29.03.2026.

Taking all these facts into consideration, I.A.No.7078/2026, is allowed and appellant Ranjeet Sen be released on temporary bail, on 28.03.2026 at 10.00 A.M., on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only), with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with clear understanding that he will surrender before the concerned trial Court on 31.03.2026 at 05.00 P.M., positively, and in case the appellant does not surrender, the concerned trial Court will be free to take necessary steps for taking him into custody.
